store.name: Store board
store.pages: homepages, product pages, offer / landing pages, quizzes

types.name: Announcement / promo bar
types.desc: Thin top strip with a sale, free shipping or offer message, sometimes rotating or with a countdown.

types.name: Header & navigation
types.desc: Logo, menu, cart and search icons at the very top.

types.name: Homepage hero
types.desc: First big banner on a homepage: image or video, headline, subhead and CTA button(s).

types.name: Product page above the fold (buy box)
types.desc: Product gallery plus title, star rating, price, variant pickers and add-to-cart on a product page. Includes the buy box when it sits beside or below the gallery.

types.name: Landing page hero
types.desc: Top of a dedicated ad landing page (not homepage, not article): bold promise headline, hero image, offer or CTA.

types.name: Bundle / quantity offer selector
types.desc: Tiered offer cards: buy 1 / buy 2 / buy 3, 'most popular', 'best value', per-unit price, savings badges.

types.name: Subscribe & save selector
types.desc: One-time vs subscription choice with discount, delivery frequency and subscription perks.

types.name: Offer / pricing block
types.desc: Standalone section presenting the deal: price anchor, discount, what you get, CTA. Not the PDP buy box.

types.name: Free gifts / gift with purchase
types.desc: Section showing free bonuses or gifts unlocked with the order.

types.name: Urgency / countdown / scarcity
types.desc: Countdown timers, 'sale ends', low stock, sell-out warnings as their own section.

types.name: Upsell / frequently bought together
types.desc: Add-ons, 'complete the routine', pairs-well-with, bundle builders on a product page.

types.name: Final CTA / closing banner
types.desc: Bottom-of-page block re-stating the promise with a big button (try it today, shop now) after the persuasion.

types.name: Trust badges / icon bar
types.desc: Row of icons + short labels: free shipping, money-back, made in USA, cruelty-free, secure checkout.

types.name: As seen in / press logos
types.desc: Media or retailer logos, press quotes, 'featured in'.

types.name: Testimonials / review cards
types.desc: Curated customer quotes as cards or carousel with names, stars, photos.

types.name: Full reviews widget
types.desc: Review app section (Judge.me, Okendo, Yotpo, Loox...): rating summary, histogram, filters, list of reviews.

types.name: UGC / video testimonials / social feed
types.desc: Customer videos, TikTok-style reels, Instagram feed, creator content carousel.

types.name: Before & after
types.desc: Side-by-side or slider transformations, result photos.

types.name: Stats / clinical results
types.desc: Big numbers and percentages: '93% saw results', '1M+ customers', study results, rating counts.

types.name: Expert / doctor endorsement
types.desc: Doctor, vet, dermatologist, scientist or advisory board recommending the product, with credentials.

types.name: Guarantee / risk reversal
types.desc: Money-back guarantee, trial period, warranty: badge + explanation as a section.

types.name: Certifications / quality standards
types.desc: Third-party tested, GMP, NSF, clinically tested, standards checklist, lab seals.

types.name: Benefits (icons / grid)
types.desc: Key benefits as icons or tiles with short labels (what it does for you).

types.name: Image + text feature block
types.desc: Split layout: image or video one side, heading + copy + bullets the other. One feature or benefit explained.

types.name: Ingredients breakdown
types.desc: Key ingredients or materials with images, doses, what each does.

types.name: How it works / mechanism / science
types.desc: Explains the mechanism or science: diagrams, layers, 'the science behind'.

types.name: How to use / steps
types.desc: Step 1-2-3 usage instructions, routine steps, application guide.

types.name: Comparison (us vs them)
types.desc: Comparison table or side-by-side vs competitors, alternatives or 'other brands'; checkmarks vs crosses.

types.name: Problem / pain points
types.desc: Names the customer's problem or frustrations, 'sound familiar?', symptoms list, agitation before the solution.

types.name: Results timeline
types.desc: What to expect over time: day 1, week 2, month 3.

types.name: Who it's for / use cases
types.desc: Personas, use cases, 'perfect for', 'is this for you?' qualifiers.

types.name: Specs / product details / tabs
types.desc: Technical specs, dimensions, what's in the box, product description tabs and accordions on the PDP.

types.name: Myths vs facts / objection handling
types.desc: Addresses doubts directly: myth vs fact, 'is it safe?', 'why it's different', skepticism busters.

types.name: FAQ
types.desc: Frequently asked questions, usually accordions.

types.name: Video / demo section
types.desc: Brand or product demo video as its own section (not UGC grid).

types.name: Product grid / bestsellers carousel
types.desc: Featured products with images, prices, ratings and add-to-cart: bestsellers, new arrivals.

types.name: Shop by category / need
types.desc: Category, collection, concern or need tiles that link to collections.

types.name: Quiz / product finder
types.desc: Invites the visitor to take a quiz or find their match, or the quiz itself.

types.name: Bundle builder / build your kit
types.desc: Interactive pick-your-items bundle builder.

types.name: Brand story / founder / mission
types.desc: Founder story, why we started, mission, values, manifesto.

types.name: Community / social follow
types.desc: Community stats, follow us, hashtag, Instagram grid CTA.

types.name: Sustainability / giving back / values
types.desc: Eco, charity, donation, sourcing and ethics.

types.name: Blog / articles / education hub
types.desc: Article cards, guides, journal.

types.name: Rewards / loyalty / referral
types.desc: Points program, refer-a-friend, VIP club.

types.name: Scrolling marquee / statement banner
types.desc: Moving text ticker or big one-line statement/slogan strip.

types.name: Rich text / statement
types.desc: Simple centered heading + paragraph, no strong visual.

types.name: Image / lifestyle banner or gallery
types.desc: Full-width lifestyle image, mid-page banner or image gallery with little copy.

types.name: Shipping / returns info
types.desc: Delivery times, shipping policy, returns explained as a section.

types.name: Payment options / financing
types.desc: Pay-later, installments (Klarna, Afterpay, Shop Pay), HSA/FSA eligibility or financing explained as its own block.

types.name: Email / SMS signup
types.desc: Join the list, get X% off, email input field.

types.name: Footer
types.desc: Bottom links, policies, socials, payment icons, company info.

types.name: Masthead / publication bar
types.desc: Fake-news or magazine-style top bar: publication name, 'Advertorial' or 'Sponsored' label, category nav, trending bar.

types.name: Advertorial headline + byline
types.desc: Article headline, subhead, author/byline, date, read time, editorial hero image.

types.name: Listicle headline / intro
types.desc: 'X reasons why...' title, short intro and hero for a listicle.

types.name: Hook / opening lead
types.desc: First paragraphs that hook: a surprising claim, a relatable moment, a question, a pattern interrupt.

types.name: Story / narrative
types.desc: The character's journey: struggle, turning point, what happened. Long-form editorial copy with images.

types.name: Problem / symptoms checklist
types.desc: 'Sound familiar?' symptoms, pain points, checklist of frustrations.

types.name: Stakes / what happens if ignored
types.desc: Agitation: how it gets worse, risks, cost of doing nothing.

types.name: Why other solutions fail
types.desc: What they already tried (diets, creams, pills, doctors) and why it didn't work.

types.name: Root cause / mechanism reveal
types.desc: The hidden cause or 'new mechanism': science, diagrams, charts, studies explaining the real problem.

types.name: Discovery / product introduction
types.desc: The moment the product is revealed: 'that's when I found...', product hero shot, what it is.

types.name: How the product works / ingredients
types.desc: Ingredients, steps or technology inside the product and what each does.

types.name: Listicle reason block
types.desc: One numbered reason: number + heading + image/GIF + short copy (+ inline link).

types.name: Comparison vs alternatives
types.desc: Table or side-by-side vs other options, competitors, or the old way.

types.name: How to use / routine
types.desc: Simple usage steps, 'just X a day'.

types.name: Testimonials / reviews
types.desc: Customer quotes, review cards, star ratings inside the pre-sell.

types.name: Facebook-style comments
types.desc: Social comment thread section: avatars, names, likes, replies.

types.name: Before & after
types.desc: Transformation photos, result images.

types.name: Stats / study results / social proof numbers
types.desc: Big numbers, % results, customer counts, sold-out counts, press mentions.

types.name: Expert / doctor / authority
types.desc: Doctor, scientist or expert quote, credentials, endorsement.

types.name: What to expect / results timeline
types.desc: Day/week/month timeline of results.

types.name: Offer box / deal block
types.desc: Discount, price, bundle options, free gifts, CTA button: the closing offer.

types.name: Inline CTA / button bar
types.desc: Mid-article call to action: button, 'check availability', link bar.

types.name: Guarantee / risk reversal
types.desc: Money-back guarantee, trial, risk-free badge.

types.name: Urgency / scarcity
types.desc: Stock warnings, countdowns, sell-out notices, 'sale ends'.

types.name: FAQ
types.desc: Questions and answers / objection handling in accordion or list form.

types.name: Author bio / editor note
types.desc: Box about the writer or editor.

types.name: Disclaimer / references / footer
types.desc: FDA disclaimers, 'this is an advertisement', references, footer links.

types.name: Gamified discount / prize reveal
types.desc: Spin-to-win wheel, flip-a-card, pick-a-box or scratch reveal that unlocks a discount or free gift.

types.name: Counterfeit / only-sold-here warning
types.desc: Warns about knock-offs and says the product is only sold on this site.

types.name: Contact / help block
types.desc: 'Need help?' block with email, chat or phone support details.

types.name: Embedded buy box / product card
types.desc: A product card or mini buy box inside the pre-sell: image, rating, price, variant/quantity pick and add-to-cart.

types.name: How we ranked / review methodology
types.desc: 'How we tested', ranking criteria and scoring used in best-of / top-5 comparison listicles.

types.name: Counterfeit / only-sold-here warning
types.desc: Warns about knock-offs on Amazon etc. and says to buy only from the official site.

types.name: Related articles / more stories
types.desc: Blog-style 'you may also like' article cards at the end of a pre-sell.

types.name: Find in store / retail locator
types.desc: Store finder, retailer logos or 'available at' block, store hours and directions.

types.name: Other / unclear
types.desc: Doesn't fit any type, broken capture, blank, cookie banner, or loading state.

types.name: Other / unclear
types.desc: Doesn't fit, broken capture, blank, cookie banner.
